regimes.spy_direction: sign of SPY cumulative return known through event bar
regimes.smh_direction: sign of SMH cumulative return known through event bar
regimes.market_volatility: high when causal 20-session same-slot volatility exceeds its prior-session median, otherwise low
regimes.day_shape: trend when causal efficiency ratio through event bar is at least 0.60, otherwise range
regimes.vix: not used because frozen local inputs do not include VIX

placebo.success: real confirmation improvement exceeds the 95th percentile of placebo improvement and future-to-past is not accepted as legitimate evidence

leave_one_event_out.event_concentrated_if: sign/classification changes or maximum single-event contribution exceeds 50 percent of full absolute effect
